WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    rfistat,
    AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS baseline_value
  FROM status_averages
),
kept_statuses AS (
  SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex
  FROM status_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE sa.avg_modindex > b.baseline_value
),
kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS mean_value
  FROM kept_statuses
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(ks.rfistat, 'No Status') AS status,
  ks.avg_modindex,
  ks.avg_modindex - b.baseline_value AS above_baseline,
  ks.avg_modindex - km.mean_value AS diff_from_kept_mean
FROM kept_statuses ks
CROSS JOIN baseline b
CROSS JOIN kept_mean km;
